title: Concept: LDAP filter echoed in an error
description: An LDAP search filter with its syntax error in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The filter shows which attribute the login checks and how the value is concatenated, which is exactly what a filter-injection attempt needs to see.
applicability: Deployments that render an LDAP search filter with its syntax error into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The filter shows which attribute the login checks and how the value is concatenated, which is exactly what a filter-injection attempt needs to see.
